thread:
Chris Osei: Heads up: **Redwood Console → Optimize → Suggestions (BETA)** is internally ready for cohort enablement. :rocket:

This is the new read-only Suggestions view (batching + caching recs) with estimated savings + risk level + “basis of estimate” telemetry. No one-click apply yet — we’re gating behind flags + allowlist.

**What’s shipping in beta (phase 1)**
- Suggestions list + detail drawer (route/model/region scoped)
- Savings estimate model (v1) + confidence interval + “last updated”
- Risk taxonomy (Low/Medium/High) + rationale bullets
- Telemetry + analytics events for viewed/opened
- RBAC + audit logging for read access

**How to request enablement (per tenant/workspace)**
1) File an internal request (preferred): Jira **INT** ticket (template) → “Enable Suggestions beta”
   - Include: tenant_id, workspace_id, deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), primary routes to validate, CSM/SE owner, and whether customer is OK with weekly feedback check-ins
2) Or ping in #product-optimize with the same info and we’ll open the ticket for you.

Once approved, Release Eng will:
- Add tenant to allowlist
- Flip `suggestions_beta` flag on prod for that tenant
- Confirm RBAC roles (must have Console permission `optimize:suggestions:view`)

**Docs / runbooks / dashboards**
- Console docs draft (internal): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/console-optimize-suggestions-beta
- Enablement how-to (flags + allowlist): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/enable-suggestions-beta-feature-flag
- Risk taxonomy ADR-0274: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/adr-0274-suggestions-risk-taxonomy
- Savings contract ADR-0275: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/adr-0275-savings-estimation-contract
- SRE oncall readiness: https://drive.google.com/redwood/sre/suggestions-beta-oncall-readiness
- Service dashboards: https://grafana.redwoodinference.com/d/suggestions-service-overview (p95, 5xx, stale-estimate detector)

**Known beta limitations / guardrails**
- Read-only UI (no apply workflow)
- Suggestions suppressed if telemetry freshness < threshold or insufficient baseline coverage
- “High risk” suggestions will show rationale; some categories are suppressed entirely per guardrails

We’re aiming to enable the first 3–5 tenants starting this week. Please route customer comms through your CSM/SE owner and set expectations that estimates are directional.

(reactions: :eyes: 38, :thumbsup: 22)

Aditya Rao: +1 — big thanks to Console + ML + telemetry folks for getting this to a shippable state. For cohort requests, please include the customer’s top 1–2 routes so we can sanity-check the savings basis before enabling.

Marissa Cole: If you’re demoing, please use the wording “estimated savings” (not “guaranteed”) and point to the “basis of estimate” section in the drawer. We’ve got a couple of copy nits still in flight but it’s good for beta.

Dylan Brooks: Engineering note: flag is enforced server-side in BFF + UI. If a tenant isn’t allowlisted, they’ll get the empty state + “not enabled” messaging (no data leaks). If you see anything else, please escalate ASAP.

Chloe Martin: Also: API schema is versioned on the service side. If you’re pulling data from the suggestions-service directly (please don’t in prod), make sure you’re using the v1 fields. Console is already pinned.

ReleaseBot: Release train update: `console-web@2024.03.19.2` deployed to prod (feature-gated). `suggestions-service@1.7.0` deployed to prod. Monitoring enabled. (reactions: :white_check_mark: 14)

Connor O'Brien: Enablement SLA: once we have an INT ticket with tenant/workspace IDs + owner, we can usually turn it around same business day. Please don’t DM requests without IDs — we need the audit trail.

Rafael Mendes: SRE ask: if you’re enabling for a tenant with known traffic spikes / long-context workloads, call it out in the ticket. We have alert thresholds tuned for the initial cohort and want to avoid false positives. Criteria to pause beta are in the oncall doc.

Dev Patel: Support readiness: we’ve got canned responses for the top questions (why no suggestions, why risk is high, why savings changed week-to-week). If you get a customer question you can’t answer quickly, open a SUP ticket + tag me and Rachel.

Rachel Kim: CS note: for enterprise accounts, please schedule a 20–30 min walkthrough after enablement so we can capture “trust” feedback early (are they reading rationale? do they believe the basis?). We’ll coordinate a weekly cohort check-in.

Naomi Feldman: Security reminder: suggestions are derived from usage/cost telemetry. Don’t screenshot/share outside the account team. RBAC is required; audit logs are on for suggestions read access. If a customer asks about data handling, use the approved FAQ language.

Allison Grant: Observability: if you see stale estimates or missing-baseline issues, link the request + tenant ID in #eng-sre. We’ve got a tracer hook to correlate “insufficient telemetry” UI state with pipeline freshness.

Chris Osei: Adding the INT ticket template link here (internal): https://jira.redwoodinference.com/secure/CreateIssueDetails!init.jspa?pid=INT&issuetype=Enablement&summary=Enable%20Suggestions%20beta

Please include “Suggestions beta” in the summary so it routes correctly.

Aditya Rao: For anyone collecting feedback: please paste notes into the cohort sheet (even if it’s messy). We’re specifically tracking: (1) did they understand risk vs confidence, (2) did they trust the savings number, (3) did they find it actionable.

Chris Osei: Last thing — if you hit the “insufficient data” state but the tenant clearly has traffic, don’t assume it’s user error. We’ve had a couple telemetry freshness edge cases; file the ticket so telemetry can investigate.
